I: › When the sea or tide ebbs, it moves away from the coast and falls to a lower level.
› If a physical or emotional feeling ebbs, it becomes less strong or disappears.

NONE: › the tide when it is moving away from the coast
› the way in which the level of something regularly becomes higher or lower in a situation

example: You have to accept the ebb and flow of love in a relationship.
你得承受戀愛過程中愛情的起起伏伏。

NONE: › the regular movement of the sea away from the coast
